keyFindings.title: Auto-dispatch rejected: advisory-only hook and interactive doctor mode
Fake skill ids rejected: kind=command bridges already exist
Special doctor threshold rejected: calibration is uniform
Advisor repo-state inspection rejected: state work belongs to doctor batteries
Live _routes.yaml reads rejected: scoring reads the pinned projection
Stuffing skill metadata rejected: wrong destination for doctor phrases
Relaxing the input gate rejected: several targets mutate real state
MCP server for doctor rejected: no MCP transport by architecture
Always-on onboarding text rejected: injection budget and honesty
Fallback routing table rejected: bounded fallback text
Onboarding-as-skill rejected: the command family owns the surface
Big-bang admission rejected: contested phrases tie, stage the rollout
